name: EPIC 201752854
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 12.9 solar radii and 0.99 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201752854 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.857901 (16th-84th percentiles 12.321733-13.393479), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 7,056 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.99 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,867 K at its surface.
